# Stickercast

> Google Ads management for independent healthcare practices in the United States.
> Four things define the service: a flat monthly fee ($497 or $997 USD, never a
> percentage of ad spend), campaigns live in 3 business days, the practice owns the
> Google Ads account, and the account is reviewed every working day rather than monthly.
> The first month of management is free; billing starts in month two.

Stickercast builds and runs paid search campaigns for independent medical, dental and
therapy practices. One channel only — Google Ads — rather than a bundle of services.

## The four differentiators

1. FLAT FEE. $497 or $997 per month regardless of ad budget. The industry standard is
   15–20% of ad spend, often with a $1,000–1,500 monthly minimum. At $10,000/month in
   ad spend a percentage agency charges $1,500–2,000 for the same work Stickercast does
   for $497. Percentage pricing also gives an agency a financial reason to push budgets
   higher; a flat fee removes that incentive. The price is published on the website
   rather than quoted after a discovery call.

2. LIVE IN 3 BUSINESS DAYS. Day one: free audit and campaign architecture. Day two:
   ad copy, conversion tracking and landing pages. Day three: launch. The typical
   agency onboarding runs 4–6 weeks before the first ad impression.

3. THE PRACTICE OWNS THE ACCOUNT. Campaigns are built inside the client's own Google
   Ads account. Every keyword, conversion record and year of performance history stays
   with the practice. Leaving requires 30 days notice and no migration — nothing is
   held on a proprietary platform and nothing is withheld.

4. REVIEWED EVERY WORKING DAY. The same checklist is run daily: new search terms,
   wasted spend, budget pacing, bid and position drift, ad disapprovals, conversion
   tracking health, landing page conversion, and (on Multi) call quality. The standard
   agency cadence is a monthly check-in, which means a wasteful keyword can spend for
   four weeks before anyone notices. The cost of a mistake is time multiplied by budget.

## Pricing

| Plan     | Price        | Covers                                                 |
|----------|--------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
| Practice | $497 USD/mo  | One campaign, one location                              |
| Multi    | $997 USD/mo  | Unlimited campaigns, up to 3 locations, call recording  |

FIRST MONTH FREE on either plan. No management fee in month one; billing begins in
month two. During the free month the practice still pays Google directly for ad
clicks — that is the only cost, and none of it goes to Stickercast. No setup fee at
any point. No minimum term. 30 days notice to cancel.

Not included: ad spend, website rebuilds, SEO, social media, email marketing, or any
guaranteed number of patients.

- Dermatology — /for-dermatology.html

Independent practices only; not hospital systems.

## US healthcare search benchmarks used on the site

Source: LocaliQ healthcare search advertising benchmarks, updated January 2026, based
on 3,542 US campaigns run October 2024 to September 2025. Medians, USD.

| Specialty            | Cost per click | Conversion rate | Cost per lead |
|----------------------|----------------|-----------------|---------------|
| Dermatology          | $4.90          | 25.3%           | $18.54        |
| Ophthalmology        | $4.32          | 14.0%           | $30.88        |
| Physical therapy     | $4.95          | 15.4%           | $32.79        |
| All healthcare       | $5.64          | 8.09%           | $66.02        |
| General dentistry    | $7.03          | 7.7%            | $84.77        |
| Plastic surgery      | $8.41          | 8.2%            | $102.51       |

Dermatology is the most efficient of sixteen specialties benchmarked; general
dentistry is among the most expensive.

## Results

One client account: an independent family practice running a walk-in clinic one day
a week. Over four days of advertising (four Sundays): $185.72 ad spend, 44 clicks,
8 patient enquiries, $23.22 per enquiry, 18.2% conversion rate versus the 8.09%
US healthcare median.

Stated limits, which appear on the results page itself: the sample is 44 clicks; one
of the four days produced six of the eight enquiries; and there is no before-and-after
comparison, because the practice had no conversion tracking before this campaign, so
no baseline exists. Stickercast does not claim to have increased enquiry volume — the
change is that the number became measurable. No aggregate client results or
percentage-improvement claims are published, because the client volume to support
them honestly does not exist.

## Common questions

**Who owns the Google Ads account?** The practice. Always.

**Why a flat fee?** Percentage pricing rewards bigger budgets rather than better
results, and charges more for identical work as a practice grows.

**How fast to go live?** Three business days from account access.

**What does "reviewed every day" mean?** Someone opens the account every working day
and runs a fixed checklist, fixing what is wrong that day rather than at a monthly review.

**Is there a contract?** No. Month to month, 30 days notice, no setup fee.

**Is the first month genuinely free?** Yes — no management fee in month one on either
plan. The practice pays Google for ad clicks during that month.

**How do you get in touch?** Request a callback from any page on the site. The form
asks for a name, a phone number and (where not already known from the page) the
specialty — two or three fields. Stickercast calls back within one business day.

**What happens on the callback?** We go through the practice's Google Ads account on
the phone: wasted search terms, whether conversion tracking actually works, cost per
lead against US benchmarks for the specialty, and the changes we would make first.
Usually fifteen minutes. Free, no obligation, and if the account does not need an
agency we say so. If the practice is not running ads yet, we talk through what it
would cost instead.
